exposure: Anemia status (Hb < 10.5 g/dL vs. Hb >= 10.5 g/dL)
cohort: The study included 100 term pregnant women (18-45 years, ASA II) undergoing elective cesarean delivery under spinal anesthesia.
finding: In anemic patients undergoing cesarean delivery under spinal anesthesia, the postoperative QTc interval and f(QRS-T) angle increased significantly compared with both baseline values and non-anemic counterparts.
